Hello,

I am trying to run the following code in server.R but receiving the an error "Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'sortc' not found" .
Please suggest how this may be resolved. Is it something to do with environments in R?

output$summaryplot<-renderPlot({
 
      if (length(input$variable)) {
     
         sampling<-input$sampling 
     
        decreasing<-input$decreasing

        sortc<-input$sortCol
        print(sortc) #diagnostics
       
        tableplot(numvars,sortCol=sortc,decreasing=decreasing,sample=sampling)

      }
 }) # end of summaryplot
